articles.summary: PriceSmart, Inc. ("PriceSmart", the "Company," "we", or "our") (NASDAQ: PSMT), operator of 59 warehouse clubs in 12 countries and one U.S. territory, announced that it began selling memberships in Chile on November 10 th , ahead of the planned opening of its first club in the country located at Mallplaza Los Dominicos in Las Condes, Santiago, and is expected to open in the spring of 2027. Chile will become PriceSmart's 14th market, building on a 30-year track record of operating and growing the Membership Club model across the region. "We are pleased to bring PriceSmart to Chile and to begin welcoming our first Members. Our membership model has proven resilient across very different markets, and we believe it can give Chilean families and small businesses a new and appealing way to shop. We see ourselves as responsible for serving our Members' best interests, working on their behalf to deliver quality and value they can count on. We are encouraged by the early response as we prepare
articles.title: PriceSmart Begins Membership Sales in Chile, Advancing Its Expansion to a 14th Market
